video_title: PART 2 | Dimitris Giannakopoulos (DPG): Jokic, Pavlos Giannakopoulos & Legacy

quotes.speaker: Dimitris Giannakopoulos
quotes.summary_phrase: Dimitris Giannakopoulos on missing out on signing Milos Teodosic
quotes.excerpt: the person which I would love to have signed up until now stopped basketball, that's Milos Teodosic
quotes.quote: Unfortunately the person which I would love to have signed up until now stopped basketball, that's Milos Teodosic. And the one player which is a dream of mine and I haven't signed, I will sign next year.

quotes.speaker: Dimitris Giannakopoulos
quotes.summary_phrase: Dimitris Giannakopoulos criticizes the incident between Tariq Jones and Kendrick Nunn
quotes.excerpt: The incidence between the athlete unacceptable, especially when it's not in the heat of the game
quotes.quote: The incidence between the athlete unacceptable, especially when it's not in the heat of the game, but it's in the locker rooms. This makes it terrible. I understand something might happen on the court, your blood pressure is at 1000 degrees, but we are all of us an example towards people, we should try and keep our calmness.

quotes.speaker: Dimitris Giannakopoulos
quotes.summary_phrase: Dimitris Giannakopoulos supports severe sanctions for locker room incidents
quotes.excerpt: in these kind of cases severe sanctions should be in place in order to
quotes.quote: I think that in these kind of cases severe sanctions should be in place in order to, and also because they are unacceptable. Now of course compared to paying 300,000 for not for entering an arena, which I had to pay in the Jordi days, it's nothing. I paid 2.2 million all together.

quotes.speaker: Dimitris Giannakopoulos
quotes.summary_phrase: Dimitris Giannakopoulos on the team's loss to Valencia
quotes.excerpt: most of our guys believed that after 2-0 it was going to be an easy night
quotes.quote: My personal opinion is that most of our guys believed that after 2-0 it was going to be an easy night, where there is no easy nights, there is no easy games, especially against Valencia which was one of the really, really, really good teams this year. Maybe a few calls were a bit exaggerated, and I think that one brought the other, then losing the first match you start being anxious.

quotes.speaker: Dimitris Giannakopoulos
quotes.summary_phrase: Dimitris Giannakopoulos on Zeljko Obradovic's vision for European basketball
quotes.excerpt: what Master Zeljko has in his head is something that we will never going to see before
quotes.quote: I think that what Master Zeljko has in his head is something that we will never going to see before in European basketball. And because European basketball is going towards that direction, that what he has in mind, big bodies fast, big bodies fast game.

quotes.speaker: Dimitris Giannakopoulos
quotes.summary_phrase: Dimitris Giannakopoulos on his long-standing relationship with Zeljko Obradovic
quotes.excerpt: when you've been with him 13 years, when after that you've kept connections for another 13 years
quotes.quote: Zeljko is a person who, when you've been with him 13 years, when after that you've kept connections for another 13 years. In every single Pavlos Giannakopoulos tournament he was the first to be invited, the first to to to even answer. At some point I was thinking maybe I don't even have to send the invitation, just the dates and he's going to be there.

quotes.speaker: Dimitris Giannakopoulos
quotes.summary_phrase: Dimitris Giannakopoulos praises Kostas Sloukas as a leader
quotes.excerpt: There is a player who is like this all his life, which is Kostas Sloukas
quotes.quote: There is a player who is like this all his life, which is Kostas Sloukas. He's a person who embodies a real captain, a real professional, a real, how can I say, leader.

quotes.speaker: Dimitris Giannakopoulos
quotes.summary_phrase: Dimitris Giannakopoulos on the blessing of having Juancho Hernangomez
quotes.excerpt: this is a blessing to have a human, a player, an athlete like like Juancho
quotes.quote: This is a blessing to have a human, a player, an athlete like like Juancho. His brain works on a whole different level. He has an IQ and an EQ. He's a philanthropist, he's always laughing, he's always happy, he's always trying to see the good things in life, he's always trying to help everybody else. He's just amazing.

quotes.speaker: Dimitris Giannakopoulos
quotes.summary_phrase: Dimitris Giannakopoulos on his desire to sign Miroslav Raduljica
quotes.excerpt: the person which I would love to have signed up until now stopped basketball
quotes.quote: Unfortunately the person which I would love to have signed up until now stopped basketball and became a, I think he's an assistant coach, he's a general manager, that's Miroslav Raduljica. I think that probably after Sarunas, most clever person on the court. After Dimitris Diamantidis, the most multi-talented player on the court. I think these three are let's say on a league of their own.

quotes.speaker: Dimitris Giannakopoulos
quotes.summary_phrase: Dimitris Giannakopoulos on his friendship with Dejan Bodiroga
quotes.excerpt: Dayan has been for Panathinaikos a legend. Dayan has been for European basketball a legend
quotes.quote: Dayan has been for Panathinaikos a legend. Dayan has been for European basketball a legend. And Dayan, most of all, is a friend. Is a friend. So putting everything aside, he's a friend.

quotes.speaker: Dimitris Giannakopoulos
quotes.summary_phrase: Dimitris Giannakopoulos on learning from his mistakes
quotes.excerpt: Everything we do in life are is what builds us, what we're made of
quotes.quote: Everything we do in life are is what builds us, what we're made of. So we're made of positives, negatives, correct decisions, mistakes. So I don't know if I actually regret things. I go back and try to replay them in my mind and see what I should have done different.

quotes.speaker: Dimitris Giannakopoulos
quotes.summary_phrase: Dimitris Giannakopoulos on the values he learned from his father
quotes.excerpt: My father used to help many many people. He was always an open-hearted person
quotes.quote: My father used to help many many people. He was always an open-hearted person. He used to remember, because you said you, he used to remember the names of a thousand maybe 600 people back then that used to work for us, what school they went to, what grade they're in, he used to remember everything.

quotes.speaker: Dimitris Giannakopoulos
quotes.summary_phrase: Dimitris Giannakopoulos on the legacy of his father
quotes.excerpt: There's so many things I took from my father which I would like to pass over
quotes.quote: There's so many things I took from my father which I would like to pass over. A very clean name which opens every kind of door. You just told me a story. How many people have the the the luxury to have a father where so many stories are going around about how good of a person he was, how he's helped people around.

quotes.speaker: Dimitris Giannakopoulos
quotes.summary_phrase: Dimitris Giannakopoulos on the importance of respect in modern society
quotes.excerpt: Society was more clean back then and it was easier to leave a clean name
quotes.quote: Society was more clean back then and it was easier to leave a clean name because in the past it would be it was more important to be respected than to be intimidated. In today's world, I don't know how much respect is respected.
